reason: I forget pills at home all the time and travel a lot, so one sachet with the 2 capsules already counted is something I can toss in my gym bag. The lab report behind the QR code and the empty-box guarantee make one box at $24.99 a low-risk try.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I'm paying extra for the packaging and the report, and I'm not sure I'll care about that after a week.
would_change_my_mind: A regular price closer to $24.99 so it doesn't feel like a launch-price trick.
